breakdown.description: The prompt forms the strain energy with a constant peak moment, even though the cantilever bending moment under an end load varies along the span.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly ignored the user's flawed instruction to use a constant peak moment. Instead, it generated the correct, variable bending moment function for a cantilever beam: 'M(x) = –P·(L – x)'. This aligns with the ground truth's instruction to 'set up M(x)' and use it in the strain energy integral, thereby fixing the physical inaccuracy of the original prompt.
